title: Bound P104 moment arithmetic and reduce complete pricing replay by 16x
body:
The complete PR6453 price/compiler/outer command has a median runtime of **0.99 s versus 15.98 s (16.16×)** against PR6395's exact integer-Taylor arithmetic, with the same complete displayed receipt. Three alternating fresh-process pairs are retained. This measures the full pricing path from launch through serialization; native and caller receipts remain pinned inputs.

The changed numerical contract rounds outward throughout the retained 80-term logarithm and 48-term exponential. The written proof contains the original rational endpoints while bounding intermediate arithmetic. Actual exponential denominator sizes fall from at most 82,380 bits to at most 161 bits. The complete source receipt first passes at 124 bits; 123 fails, and the default uses 160 bits. No kappa or frontier change.

Evidence: 266 exponential and 725 logarithm fixtures, every live rank-power enclosure, all 108 actual exponential calls, actual arithmetic mutants, invalid-input rejection, two arithmetic engines and all 54 strict/four functional outer predicates. Registered CPython 3.12 normal/optimized modes pass. Exact committed bytes/modes, 32-file official export, declared-input coverage, read-only Git-free empty-PATH replay in both modes and exported-source corruption rejection pass. No timing threshold is used in CI.

Credit Nick Petalas's PR6395 and ywz65's integer-Taylor method; their exact-endpoint speedup is the baseline, not claimed again. PR6505 supplies the unchanged root certificate path. Retained zxv, Cinna Davis, Cao Yifan, Jacob Alan Sussman and construction credit remains in exact source bytes. Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bounded-dyadic-moment`.

Limits: this is proof arithmetic and source-specific local timing, not full native/caller regeneration or physical execution. Five framework assumptions remain. No independent human, Lean, Docker or optional full-history preflight is claimed; the checkout is shallow. All retained inputs are committed ancestors on this branch. No known fragile workaround is used.

Canonical main 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a, revision 8 and live overlap were rechecked before submission. [Scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5600#discussioncomment-19363977). The next useful step is complete caller integration with regenerated native, scalar and physical receipts.
